relations.assertion: Knockdown of KIF23 alleviates asthma progression by inhibiting pyroptosis.
relations.evidence: Knockdown of KIF23 alleviates the progression of asthma by inhibiting pyroptosis.

relations.assertion: Ovalbumin was used to establish a mouse model of asthma.
relations.evidence: Asthma mouse model was established with ovalbumin (OVA).

relations.assertion: Caspase-3 levels were increased in the asthma model.
relations.evidence: In the asthma model, the levels of caspase-3, IgG in serum and inflammatory factors (interleukin (IL)-1β, KC and tumour necrosis factor (TNF)-α) in serum and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid were increased.

relations.assertion: Serum IgG levels were increased in the asthma model.

relations.assertion: KIF23 was identified among seven hub genes in the asthma model through transcriptome sequencing.
relations.evidence: Transcriptome sequencing showed that there were 352 DEGs in the asthma model, and 7 hub genes including KIF23 were identified.

relations.assertion: KIF23 knockdown inhibited inflammation in BEAS-2B cells in vitro.
relations.evidence: Knockdown of KIF23 increased cell proliferation and inhibited apoptosis, inflammation and pyroptosis of BEAS-2B cells induced by IL-13 in vitro.

relations.assertion: KIF23 knockdown increased proliferation and inhibited apoptosis and pyroptosis in BEAS-2B cells in vitro.

relations.assertion: IL-13 was used to induce BEAS-2B cells in vitro.
relations.evidence: BEAS-2B cells induced by IL-13 in vitro.

relations.assertion: KIF23 knockdown inhibited inflammation in an asthma mouse model in vivo.
relations.evidence: In vivo experiments verified that knockdown of KIF23 inhibited oxidative stress, inflammation and pyroptosis to alleviate OVA-induced asthma mice.

relations.assertion: In vivo experiments verified that KIF23 knockdown alleviated asthma in mice, with inhibition of oxidative stress and pyroptosis.
relations.evidence: In vivo experiments verified that knockdown of KIF23 inhibited oxidative stress, inflammation and pyroptosis to alleviate OVA-induced asthma mice.

relations.assertion: KIF23 knockdown suppressed the p53 signalling pathway.
relations.evidence: In addition, p53 signalling pathway was suppressed by KIF23 knockdown.
